scope: Quantify the range consequence of the observed recovery-model discrepancy before a performance campaign. Development fits and a provisional low-flux comparison are not proof of better physical ranging.
prior_information: All previous source reviews, gap summaries and recovery-development outcomes are known. The 2026 full-acquisition proxy fit is public. No local pulse-location fit has yet been run. Freeze this protocol/executable before new range fits. This is retrospective development, not a blind experiment.
profile_tail: Age at least 205 ns is the reference g=1; earlier age cells have nonnegative freely profiled multiplicative intensity factors. This is a working model, not a certified recovery curve; additive afterpulsing need not obey it.
pulse_interpolation: PCHIP cumulative mass at original 8 ps calibration spacing, differentiated to a density. Preserve the arbitrary trimmed-template origin across all methods. Report delay differences as c/2 times delay, not an absolutely calibrated target distance.
discrete_coordinate_convention: Use phase bins centered at r*measured_period/K, assigning to the nearest center and carrying period wrap into the frame index. The upstream bin-mass function uses left-edge coordinates; subtract half a bin from its reported delay to align with the continuous timestamp coordinates. This explicitly declared reader convention differs from the authors' floor-binning pipeline and prevents a purely coordinate-induced half-bin delay difference.
methods: Continuous-time joint likelihood with best supported hard cutoff (smallest within-window inter-detection gap, bounded to [198,200] ns). Exact pulse exposure through endpoint antiderivatives, with all observations retained as history.

Published robust pilot and one-step code, unmodified, on reconstructed integer free-running exposures at native and published coarse bin counts. Fit the largest supported integer dead time in the allowed 198--200 ns interval, accounting for the source convention of D fully dead bins after each detection.

Joint Bernoulli likelihood at native and coarse resolution using the pinned source score and the same robust start, optimized with SciPy rather than unavailable NLopt. Multiple nearby starts; record solver outcomes and residual scores. This is an implementation of its likelihood, not a claim to reproduce the authors' complete published pipeline.
Joint continuous-time likelihood with freely profiled early recovery factors, normalized at mature ages.
Guarded joint likelihood at each specified age threshold. Guard only likelihood contributions; preserve every event as a history reset. This is not counterfactual acquisition.
intended_followup_decision: A fixed-target range report within 1 mm at 95% reliability, with a 10000-period acquisition budget (about 1 ms here), the same calibration inputs for all estimators, and at least 20% lower squared-error risk than the strongest applicable comparator. These are research benchmark requirements, not an established operational deployment need. A separate uncertainty/stability/reference protocol and adequate trial count are required before evaluating that benefit.
development_gate: A recovery correction of at least 0.2 mm (one fifth of the intended error tolerance), with consistent sign in both high-flux halves and both pulse variants, warrants the next comparison. Compare the profiled-recovery delay with the native joint Bernoulli MLE and the continuous hard-cutoff MLE. Guarded and one-step results identify whether established robust methods already supply the same answer. Failure is a negative gate for this correction's proposed role, not an impossibility theorem for lidar.
physical_limits: No exact physical error certificate from continuous timestamps or a fitted curve. The low-flux electronics dead time can hide avalanches; its 150 ns guard is a provisional convention requiring a bound on electronics plus detector recovery. Its fit is not calibrated ground truth. Pulse/background trimming, drift, timewalk, additive afterpulsing, dependence and complete recording remain unvalidated. The original phase and frame-difference coordinates avoid numerical boundary cancellation; latent 8 ps quantization is still unresolved.
verification: Synthetic exact interval exposure checks, independent direct event-interval integration, analytic score finite differences, fitted score/optimizer diagnostics, upstream source hashes, and preservation of all data beyond the existing development prefixes. No Lean/Lake, hardware, outreach, publication or final-reserve outcomes.
